verdict.rationale: Spending caps and usage alerts are a fair question for a usage-billed browser-infrastructure service, but nothing in the evidence documents budget limits, credit caps, or consumption alerts. The webhooks (docs-19) and 'alert you the moment something breaks' (docs-11) are about session events and product-monitoring agents, not billing, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set a spending cap or usage alert so proxy/credit consumption doesn't silently blow past my budget
